groupings.title: OliverSpec
groupings.description: Linear-backed explore → propose → scope → apply → babysit → ship. Install as a suite: npx skills add chroline/oliver/skills/oliverspec

groupings.title: Factory
groupings.description: Autonomous single Linear-ticket factory: plan → critique → implement → stack, then invoke Babysit. Install: npx skills add chroline/oliver/skills/factory

groupings.title: Babysit
groupings.description: Take one Linear ticket's open PRs through real CI and review fixes, explicit approval, and bottom-up merge. Install: npx skills add chroline/oliver/skills/babysit

groupings.title: Lab Notebook
groupings.description: Keep experiments and investigations in one Markdown file with a concise current summary and append-only chronological entries. Install: npx skills add chroline/oliver/skills/lab-notebook
